label: A great storm still on the horizon, delayed by months
description: A storm seen still on the horizon that may be delayed by some months or a year, given alongside his caveat about depth perception in the spirit realm.

label: A debt and lending crisis in which banks stop lending
description: Alongside the return to a 1930s depression, a debt crisis and a loaning crisis in which the banks will not allow anyone to borrow.
aliases: banks would not allow anybody to borrow

label: The underground church in Asia interceded for the US election
description: The antichrist agenda takes a severe blow because of October prayer, including the underground church in China and across Asia interceding for America over the election.

label: The Texas Senate race turns red
description: Declared in prayer over Ted Cruz's Senate race that it will not go blue but red.

label: Hidden cells in America exposed around the election
description: Hidden cells of people in America with ill intentions, prayed to be exposed and brought to justice around the 2024 election.

label: Fearful signs in the heavens: comets, asteroids, falling stars
description: Warned that fearful signs in the heavens will increase, with asteroids, stars and falling stars, after he says he prophesied a comet unknowingly.

label: The October surprise redefined as a good surprise
description: When no October surprise arrives, the term is reversed: God's surprises are not bad ones, and the surprise is that the glory is here.

label: A landslide in the House, Senate and presidency on 5 November
description: Declared in prayer: a fair election and a landslide victory across the House, the Senate and the presidency, with the result known within a couple of days.

label: Birthing pains intensify beyond comprehension over the next year
description: The great tribulation is coming and the birthing pains over the year from October 2024 intensify beyond anybody's comprehension, with no escape for believers.

label: Quakes, weather, wars and signs increase threefold
description: After Rosh Hashanah 2024, acceleration in weather, signs in the heavens, earthquakes and wars, increasing by three times.

label: Everything changes within a twenty four hour period
description: A shaking and a storm coming upon these shores, after which everything anyone has known changes within a single day.
aliases: storm that is coming upon your shores

label: The financial storm declared averted for 2025
description: He uses authority to declare that the storm will not hit as he saw it, that the financial storm is averted and that there will not be a financial crisis, going into 2025 with a clean start.
aliases: will not have a financial crisis
